output_summary: Phase 1 (Causation Lens): Generated hypotheses - large PRs, unclear requirements, reviewer bottleneck. Phase 2 (Second-Order): Traced each chain: large PRs → fast growth → no code ownership. Phase 3: Convergence found at 'no team ownership boundaries'. Phase 4: Flagged as systemic - needs structural change, not individual fixes. Output: 3 causal chains, 1 convergence point, actionable recommendation: implement CODEOWNERS + PR size limits.
test_notes: Recipe successfully composes causation_lens + second_order_lens into a 4-phase root cause analysis. Both component lenses were essential per quality gates. Emergent capability: neither lens alone would have traced through to structural ownership issues.
